name: Jayanthbharadwaj M
role: Technical Lead | Senior Full Stack Developer
description: Technical Lead & Senior Full Stack Developer with 8 years of experience architecting high-throughput backend systems, real-time IoT platforms, multi-tenant microservices, and modern web/mobile applications. Proven track record leading cross-functional teams, driving cloud security (Keycloak, Cognito, Azure AD), and delivering resilient enterprise architectures.

tasks: Led and mentored a cross-functional engineering team of 15 developers (5 direct reports) across system architecture, sprint execution, technical reviews, and engineering best practices.

Architected and deployed a smart city Lighting Management System (LMS) orchestrating 10,000+ connected smart lamps, ingesting hourly telemetry data with high reliability and zero data loss for over 1 year.

Engineered a centralized IoT Control Tower managing heterogeneous devices (Edge Gateways, CCTV Cameras, Smart Display Boards, Lamps) over MQTT, WebSockets, and REST APIs, including ONVIF camera discovery POCs.
Architected interactive Map Dashboards and geospatial analytics using MapLibre GL, and evaluated vector tiles with PMTiles for offline/low-bandwidth map rendering.
Extended enterprise Identity & Access Management (IAM) with on-premise Keycloak integration alongside cloud identity (AWS Cognito, Azure AD, MFA, passkeys, and RBAC).
Designed automated multi-tenant provisioning pipelines (database, schema, custom subdomains) and optimized PostgreSQL/Redis query performance, reducing API response times.
Implemented event-driven processing pipelines using Apache Kafka and Redis for real-time alert dispatching, telemetry processing, and automated device workflow triggers.
Led frontend engineering for real-time device monitoring dashboards using React.js, TypeScript, Context API, and WebSockets.
Engineered low-latency WebSocket display engine for Smart Pole digital signage boards, supporting real-time content broadcast and automated scheduling.
Implemented multi-tenant authentication and user lifecycle management utilizing AWS Cognito with fine-grained role-based access control.
Developed automated data migration and cloud infrastructure provisioning services across AWS environments, ensuring zero downtime during data transitions.
Served as backend developer for EdTech platform (Aulas), architecting core REST APIs for user registration, onboarding, and role-based profiles.
Implemented end-to-end fee management and payment processing workflows integrating Cashfree gateway and automated fee collection links.
Built automated multi-channel notification microservices (SMTP/SMS) and optimized database queries on PostgreSQL/MySQL.
Developed full-stack web applications using PHP, Node.js, and React.
Designed and implemented cross-platform mobile applications using React Native, published on Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
Managed database users and schemas (MySQL), ensuring high availability, smooth operation, and data integrity.
Written automated deployment and build scripts, reducing release turnaround time by 30%.
Contributed to full-stack web application development and database maintenance under senior engineering mentorship.
